resources.name: Standard crystal structures for fcc Al, bcc Li, and L12 Al3Li

access.notes: Available from ICSD, Materials Project, or built from symmetry information (space groups: Al 225, Li 229, Al3Li 221).

resources.notes: Initial lattice parameters are approximate; the calculations determine the exact equilibrium values.

resources.name: Open‑source DFT or LMTO code (e.g., Questaal, ABINIT, Quantum ESPRESSO)

access.notes: Any code that can perform all‑electron or pseudopotential LDA calculations with s, p, d valence basis and volume scans.

resources.notes: The solver must carry out self‑consistent calculations and total‑energy vs. volume scans; no specific version mandated.
